userScope: Close remaining limitations using emulated/fake platform mechanisms without a platform app.

sources.contract: Текст is mutable, accepts invalid text without validation; execution checks it. Parameter and data-source setters accept unused names and replacements. Data sources use ИЗ &Name.
Dynamic rows expose read-only lookup by string column name, as well as named properties.
Column descriptors expose readonly Имя and Тип.

Descriptors contain native type sets plus optional number, string and byte qualifiers. The emulator preserves cast qualifiers; unqualified string/bytes use 0 and numbers use explicit fake defaults 32/32.
Constructor matching tries named parameters, then positions. Unknown and nullable values may fail when reading a row instead of preventing compilation.

reference.adapter: Explicit Script emulation authorized by the user. Source-finite text uses the existing typed AST; runtime text/heterogeneous schemas use a Script SELECT AST. Mutable Text, declared array sources, readonly lookup by column name, descriptors and qualifiers, lazy nullable/unknown narrowing, installed scalar constructors, owner-scoped generated types, and an explicit historical ЗапросСВыборкой alias are supported. Rows are materialized with a single-pass resource state, not a native database cursor.
